fixtureAcceptFailure.adjudication: These two interruptions are fixture/API lifecycle coverage defects, not model false blocks or observed product revision failures. e01RepeatedCalculation.runtimeAndCodeInference: The response requests two identical sums, and the next worker input contextReads[13] and [14] records ok:true results. readRequests iterates both; second execute validates prior using valid -> evaluate -> calculate before returning prior. Thus an additional arithmetic re-evaluation occurs by this executed code path, but no separate execution event/identity is recorded or projected. Other validation paths can re-evaluate too, so exact total arithmetic evaluations is not measured.
e01RepeatedCalculation.modelObservation: Both successful contextReads alias the same toolEvidence[0], same receipt ID/hash and observedAt. No count or distinct event proves the second actual evaluation to the worker; the worker explicitly declines to invent that proof, then planner requests run_code which is off.
e01RepeatedCalculation.adjudication: Business selection and arithmetic are correct but complete business report/double-execution proof/workflow did not finish. Not a factual hallucination, false block, or evidence that the product can never finish.
e01RepeatedCalculation.nextFix: Keep stable result identity for reuse, but expose separately identifiable requested execution events and their results. Test repeated-calculation requests and planner continuation end to end; additional instructions alone do not create observability.

e02Coverage.helperIssue: Gold completeEvidenceGroups supplies fixtureFileName, while frozen groupObservation matches sourceMap.title===group.sourceTitle. The helper therefore finds no source IDs and its 0 is structurally forced. Do not use that helper output alone as evidence that no tool read occurred.
e02Coverage.independentRule: Match actual imported inspection source ID from successful read_file result; count the four exact gold quotes only in source-bound content/segments of actual input payloads. Planner and worker inputs are counted separately; a disk read or planner view does not establish worker exposure.
